template.name: AdvancedSystemQueryAnalytics
template.description: Comprehensive template for analyzing system query usage patterns and finding templates by their internal GraphQL operations
template.query: query AdvancedSystemQueryAnalytics($targetQueries: [String!], $complexityMin: Int, $usageCountMin: Int, $operationType: OperationType, $isActive: Boolean, $limit: Int) { searchTemplates(filter: { complexityMin: $complexityMin, usageCountMin: $usageCountMin, isActive: $isActive }, limit: $limit) { templates { id identifier name queryName operationType complexityScore usageCount lastUsedAt isActive tags createdAt } totalCount hasNextPage } }
